# project identifier

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:projectIdentifier`](gmeow-projectIdentifier.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/projectIdentifier>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An identifier for a project as an activity — typically a RAiD (ISO 23527). Distinct from product/release identifiers (DOI, ISO 26324). Non-functional: a project may carry multiple PIDs.
